label: Whatever is corruptible simply is existentially receptive
paraphrase: OPEN (passive to receptive), analyst formulation, attribution deferred (navigation: Met. Theta.8 1050b, what can not-be is perishable through matter): whatever can fail to be in substance (corruptible simply) has a principle open to being and non-being: it is composed of matter and form, or its esse is received in a principle in receptive potency (RECEPTIVE_POTENCY_1) to that esse.
